NAME: Force Audio Jack - Test Tone
DESCRIPTION: Minimal stand-in producer (a fixed sine wave) that proves the ForceAudioJack injection tap works end to end, on either bus. Toggling RUNNING here only starts/stops injectTone itself - it does not arm forceAudioJack.so or restart acvs, so it only reaches an Audio-In (bus=in) or Out 3/4 (bus=out) track if ForceAudioJack's own manage.sh ENABLE has already been run (it arms the tap once, persistently, at every boot). See README.md.
